metadata.evaluation_name: Pre-registered model-screen evaluation with reserved-fold confirmation
metadata.description: Evaluation of five cooling model candidates (B0-B1-C1-C2-C3) on a panel of 3 independent published datasets. Applies pre-registered survival rule: lowest heldout OOS RMSE on >=80% of datasets AND mean delta-BIC > 10 over Newton baseline B0. Paired 5000-draw bootstrap 95% CIs on pairwise RMSE and crossing-time differences. C3 tau-ablation at in-sample MLE. Power note on N=3 panel.
